title: 第17章 沐梓丞夜闯土匪窝第18章 昔小苑被抓当压寨夫人
slug: 快穿之时空星河伴第九章误闯雾山
content_zh:
昔小苑琢磨了一下，随后说道：“我们得想个办法怎么套召簧的话出来，看看这个牌子到底有什么用处！”
俞月白跟昔小苑一对眼，突然两人猥琐的奸笑，不用说就知道他们在打着什么鬼主意了。
...........分割线..........
夜，山寨里。
有个从昔小苑那里逃出来的土匪已经被他几个同伙发现抬了回去...土匪说道：“禀报大王，他被我们从郊外的一个草丛里抬了回来，而且伤势很重，找到他的时候已经昏迷着了。”
土匪头儿说道：“一群废物，快带他去治疗！”
这小娘子可真是能呀，真是小看她了，不过他喜欢！竟然能让他的兄弟们有去无回，只有一个侥幸逃了回来…到现在才找到一个还算活着的，这小娘子可真是不能小瞧了，找个机会倒要好好会会这个小娘子。
土匪头儿说道：“来人！派个人去召簧那里打探打探消息。”
召府。
昔小苑对俞月白说道：“那道具又是上次那个吗？”
俞月白摇了摇头说道：“本公子觉得不妥。”
昔小苑想了想说道：“要不把他灌醉然后套话？如果在弄鬼吓他的话那我这个道长不就发现是假的了吗~”
俞月白觉得有些道理，说道：“也是，那明天便灌醉他套话！”
不久窗户外有个人影跑过，昔小苑对俞月白做了个‘嘘’的手势，俞月白迅速闭上嘴巴不说话，随后人影跑了过去不见了。昔小苑小声对俞月白说道：“要不要跟出去看看，我看到一个人影跑过去了~”
俞月白眉头突然有些紧皱，说道：“那我们得小心点，可别被人给发现了...”
昔小苑跟俞月白悄悄的跟人影出去了，他们躲避开巡逻的守卫，随后昔小苑看见那个人跑进了召簧的屋里，昔小苑跟俞月白小心翼翼的凑了过去，躲在墙下听听他们到底在干些什么。
“大王叫我来打探打探消息，大王想知道那个丞相到底有什么本事，竟然能让去抓她的兄弟们全军覆没了。”
召簧有些紧张的说道：“全？全军覆灭了？本...本官不知呀，这几天本官病殃都没有去看那个什么丞相呀，而且本官就只是以为一介女子罢了，就没怎么放在眼里…”
“你怕是这帽子戴久了逍遥了是吧？大王说要你去看看那小娘子到底长什么样，把样子画出来，大王还要想个对策把那小娘子抓回去做压寨夫人呢！”
俞月白听到有些不爽，随后不小心动了下身子踢到了一个东西发出了动静...“谁！”召簧跑出门四周看了看，看了看并没有人~

召簧随后悄悄的把门给关上了。
“话我已经带到了，还有那小娘子有什么动向都要向我们禀报！我就先走了，免得被人发现生出事端。”
召簧立马点头说道：“是是是，一有动向一定第一时间向你们汇报的，放心！”
“最好是这样，不然我家大王是不会放过你的。”随后那人悄悄的从窗户跳了出去。
昔小苑跟俞月白躲在不远处的草丛里看见那人从窗户跳了出来，而后跑了...昔小苑跟俞月白悄悄的走了出来，随后偷偷的跑回自个屋里。
俞月白拍了拍胸口说道：“吓死我了，差点就被发现了，幸好溜得早~”
昔小苑喝了口茶水定定惊，随后说道：“现在竟然开始查起本丞相来了，还要画像？还山寨夫人？呵~”
俞月白撑着脑袋一脸不嫌事大的看着昔小苑说道：“那你现在打算怎么应对？”
昔小苑突然微微一笑，而后有些坏坏的说道：“本丞相自有办法！”
客栈。
沐梓丞躺在榻上安安静静悠闲的看着书，突然觉得有些怪无聊的~阿苑那傻孩子跟那臭小子出去搞事情了~现在留他一人在这无聊着，不行！他也要出去逛逛。
沐梓丞走在大街上，街上人很少，那红红的灯笼高高的挂在每户家家的门户上，沐梓丞看着这里的环境……
要不去山寨逛逛？顺便把土匪头儿给杀了？！不然等阿苑那傻孩子剿土匪得等多久？她效率太低。
就这样~沐梓丞悠悠闲闲的来到山寨，沐梓丞站在土匪寨子的门口，随后走了进去……
沐梓丞看见土匪头儿进入了一个屋子里，沐梓丞随后也跟了进去，土匪头儿脱了衣服剩了件里衣就直接躺在床上了.....
随后还猥琐的说道：“嘿嘿，那小娘子现在一定是睡了，不过很快就会成为我的夫人了~”土匪头儿打着主意，随后闭上了眼睛翻了个身睡去，后背正好对着沐梓丞。
沐梓丞默默的翻了个白银，阿苑那臭丫头有什么好的~选谁不好选她？那你可得倒霉了，那就先杀了你再说。
沐梓丞看见桌上有把小短刀，他悄悄的拿过那把小短刀，慢慢的拔开~随后悄悄地靠近土匪头儿，沐梓丞正要刺下去的时候.....
土匪头儿突然翻了个身躲避开了沐梓丞的攻击，随后他看见一把小短刀插在了床上，但是就是看不见人，随后土匪头儿吼道：“谁！给本大爷出来，躲着可没意思！”
小主，这个章节后面还有哦，请点击下一页继续阅读，后面更精彩！

沐梓丞知道自己失手了，但是也不好纠缠，不然打草惊蛇对后面的计划可就不利了，沐梓丞扯着嗓子像个老人的声音说道：“你做出伤天害理的事，打劫钱财，抢强民女，你可知道自己犯了死罪，天是不会放过你的！”
土匪头儿拿着大砍刀往那声音的来源方向坎了过去，他没有被吓到，反而很是警惕的说道：“谁？有本事就出来！吓唬谁呢？大爷我才不怕呢，还天？有本事就一道雷劈死我…”
content_en:
Xi Xiaoyuan thought about it for a while, and then said: "We have to find a way to trick the call out and see what the use of this brand is!"
Yu Yuebai and Xi Xiaoyuan looked at each other, and suddenly the two of them smiled obscenely. Needless to say, it was obvious what they were planning.
........ dividing line .......
Night, in the village.
A bandit who escaped from Xi Xiaoyuan has been discovered by several of his accomplices and carried back... The bandit said: "Report to the king, we carried him back from a bush in the suburbs, and he was seriously injured. When we found him, he was already unconscious."
The bandit leader said: "What a bunch of trash, take him to treatment quickly!"
This little lady is really capable, I really underestimated her, but he likes her! He was able to make his brothers never come back, and only one escaped by chance... Only now did he find one who was still alive. This little lady should not be underestimated. If we find a chance, we should get to know this little lady.
The bandit leader said: "Come here! Send someone to Zhaohuang to find out the news."
Zhaofu.
Xi Xiaoyuan said to Yu Yuebai, "Are those props the same as last time?"
Yu Yuebai shook his head and said, "I think it's inappropriate."
Xi Xiaoyuan thought for a moment and said, "How about getting him drunk and telling him a trick? If I'm trying to scare him with ghosts, then won't I, the Taoist Priest, find out that it's a lie~"
Yu Yuebai thought it made sense and said, "That's right. Then tomorrow I'll get him drunk and talk nonsense!"
Soon a figure ran past outside the window. Xi Xiaoyuan made a 'shh' gesture to Yu Yuebai. Yu Yuebai quickly closed his mouth and said nothing, and then the figure ran over and disappeared. Xi Xiaoyuan whispered to Yu Yuebai: "Would you like to go out with me and take a look? I saw a figure running past~"
Yu Yuebai suddenly frowned and said, "Then we have to be careful and don't get discovered..."
Xi Xiaoyuan and Yu Yuebai quietly followed the figure out. They avoided the patrolling guards. Then Xi Xiaoyuan saw the man running into Zhao Huang's room. Xi Xiaoyuan and Yu Yuebai approached carefully and hid under the wall to listen to what they were doing.
"The king asked me to come and inquire about the news. The king wants to know what the prime minister is capable of, so that he can make all the brothers who went to capture her be annihilated."
Zhao Huang said nervously: "All? The whole army was destroyed? I...I don't know. I have been ill in the past few days and I haven't even visited the prime minister. Moreover, I just thought it was just a woman, so I didn't pay much attention to it..."
"Are you afraid that you have been wearing this hat for too long? Your Majesty asked you to see what that little lady looks like and draw her likeness. Your Majesty also wants to think of a countermeasure to capture that little lady and make her his wife!"
Yu Yuebai was a little unhappy when he heard that, and then he accidentally moved his body and kicked something that made a noise... "Who!" Zhao Huang ran out and looked around, but there was no one there~
Zhaohuang then quietly closed the door.
"I've brought the message, and the young lady must report to us any movements she makes! I'll leave first to avoid being discovered and causing trouble."
Zhao Huang nodded immediately and said: "Yes, yes, I will report to you as soon as there is any movement, don't worry!"
"This is best, otherwise my king will not let you go." Then the man jumped out of the window quietly.
Xi Xiaoyuan and Yu Yuebai were hiding in the grass not far away when they saw the man jump out of the window and then ran away... Xi Xiaoyuan and Yu Yuebai walked out quietly, and then secretly ran back to their house.
Yu Yuebai patted his chest and said, "I was scared to death. I was almost discovered. Fortunately, I escaped early~"
Xi Xiaoyuan took a sip of tea to calm down, and then said: "Now the Prime Minister has started to investigate, and he still wants a portrait? Return to the mountainMrs. Zhai? Ha~"
Yu Yuebai held up his head and looked at Xi Xiaoyuan with a nonchalant expression: "Then how are you going to deal with it now? "
Xi Xiaoyuan suddenly smiled slightly, and then said a little naughtily: "I have my own way, the Prime Minister! "
Inn.
Mu Zicheng was lying on the couch and reading a book quietly and leisurely, and suddenly felt a little bored. That silly boy A Yuan and that brat went out to cause trouble. He couldn't be left alone here to be bored now! He also wants to go out for a walk.
Mu Zicheng was walking on the street. There were very few people on the street. The red lanterns were hung high on the doors of every house. Mu Zicheng looked at the environment here...
How about going to the cottage for a walk? Kill the bandit leader by the way? ! Otherwise, how long would we have to wait for that silly boy A Yuan to suppress the bandits? She is too inefficient.
Just like that~ Mu Zicheng came to the village leisurely. Mu Zicheng stood at the door of the bandit's village, and then walked in...
Mu Zicheng saw the bandit leader entering a room, and Mu Zicheng followed him in. The bandit leader took off his clothes and lay down on the bed except for his underwear...
Then he said obscenely: "Hey, that little lady must be asleep now, but she will become my wife soon~" The bandit leader made up his mind, then closed his eyes and turned over to sleep, with his back facing Mu Zicheng.
Mu Zicheng silently turned over the silver. What's so good about that stinky girl A Yuan? Who should I choose? Why not choose her? Then you're in trouble, so I'll kill you first.
Mu Zicheng saw a small dagger on the table. He quietly took the small dagger and slowly pulled it out. Then he quietly approached the bandit leader. When Mu Zicheng was about to stab him...
The bandit leader suddenly turned over to avoid Mu Zicheng's attack, and then he saw a small knife stuck on the bed, but no one could be seen, and then the bandit leader shouted: "Who! Come out to me, there's no point in hiding! "
My dear, there is more to come after this chapter. Please click on the next page to continue reading. There will be more exciting chapters later!
Mu Zicheng knew that he had made a mistake, but it was better not to get entangled, otherwise it would be detrimental to the subsequent plans. Mu Zicheng raised his voice like an old man and said: "You have done something that is harmful to nature, robbing money and raping women. Do you know that you have committed a capital crime, and God will not let you go!" "
The bandit leader took a machete and moved in the direction of the source of the sound. He was not frightened, but said very vigilantly: "Who? Come out if you can! Who are you trying to scare? I'm not afraid, uncle. How about God? If you can, strike me to death with a thunderbolt..."
